text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Did I scrub too hard when washing my face?
Or has my diet been bad...?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Is it because I did four times my usual workout, or because I mopped the classroom so hard the floor wore down and I got drenched in sweat?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Too many possibilities come to mind!
Where do I even start fixing things?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Struggling to track down the cause of the rough skin,
the breakout showed no sign of clearing up for a while...
